title: Probability of Touch: What 21-Day Management Changes
description:
Analysis of probability of touch reveals how 21-day trade management affects short option positions. Research examines SPY puts and calls across deltas from 10 to 45, showing realized probabilities differ from theoretical estimates. Understanding how delta relates to actual touch rates helps traders set appropriate position expectations and management parameters.
